description: Notes -> Node.js , express , MongoDB and bcrypt and JWT  Module -> A file of code that u can reuse module.exports npm-> Node Package Manager It installs packages and package.json lists them Event Loop work 1. Call stack -> lines one by one on main thread 2. Hand off ->slow work handled to background and moves to the next line 3. callback queue->completed background work waits in callback queue 4. Event Loop->when call stack is empty it runs callbacks in queue File System Methods 1. fs.readFile(path,"utf-8",cb) 2. fs.writeFile(path,data,cb) 3. fs.appendFile(path,data,cb) 4. fs.unlink(path,cb) Express It connects HTTP method and a path to handler that sends one response for every req It is a framework on top of node.js route = (HTTP method + path + Handler) HTTP stands for HyperText Transfer Protocol. Every request passes through middleware
